name: Murdaugh: Death in the Family Official Podcast
original_name: Murdaugh: Death in the Family Official Podcast
overview: Go behind the scenes with the creators, cast and crew of the Hulu Original series Murdaugh: Death in the Family.  Investigative journalist and host of the hit podcast True Sunlight, Mandy Matney provides a unique perspective on the stranger than fiction story and how it went from true crime podcast to television inspiration.
